ننفهق (form VII)
# نَنْفَهِقُ (nanfahiqu) /nan.fa.hi.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَهَقَ (infahaqa)
# نَنْفَهِقَ (nanfahiqa) /nan.fa.hi.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَهَقَ (infahaqa)
# نَنْفَهِقْ (nanfahiq) /nan.fa.hiq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَهَقَ (infahaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
